title: Zoberr's Overhaul
description: Rehauling Minecraft's progression. New ores, a lot of crafting recepies,and loads of weapons. All at your disposal. With their own risks. Safety not first.
body:
# 💜 Zoberr’s Tools And Armour
A mod born from power… and the consequences that follow... :)
# ⚙️ The Birth of Vinolium

Vinolium is and ore found in the depths of the Overworld.
Or you can craft it, but it's expesive:

- X4 Diamond Shards(5 from 1 Diamond)
- X4 Blaze Powder
...and a Nether Star

A union of strength, energy, and celestial power—resulting in a material that defies the natural order.

Vinolium ore can then be smelted into its usable form, unlocking tools and armor stronger than Netherite. 

# 🔥 Activated Vinolium

Through the influence of** Glowstone**, Vinolium can be awakened—refined into a more powerful, energized state.
From this, the Vinolium Upgrade Template is born, crafted using:
- X6 Iron
- X2 Vinolium
and one piece of **Activated Vinolium**

A key to unlocking true progression.

# 🌑 Vinestone — The Living Corruption
By combining Vinolium with Redstone, you create something far more unstable:
Vinestone

It is not a solid.
It is not stable.
And its clearly not benefic for your health :DD.

It is an abomination, if handeled wrong. Your enemy's end if mastered.

# ☣️ The Burden of Power — Toxicity
Vinestone does not grant power freely.
It corrupts.

The Toxicity effect weakens the player over time—draining strength, reducing efficiency, and slowly turning power into vulnerability.(only if hold)

Yet… it remains impossible to ignore. Its to powerfull. Too strong...

Because in the right hands…
it is devastating.

# ⚔️ Vinestone *EXCALIBUR*

A weapon beyond reason.

30 damage.
Inflicts Poison V
Inflicts Toxicity V
Grants Resistance II

A blade that empowers its wielder…
while slowly destroying them from within.

A weapon that does not simply fight enemies—
*…it erases them.*

# 🛠️ The Vinestone Upgrade Template
Forged from advanced materials:

- X6 Vinolium Ingots
- 1X Blackstone
- X2 Deepslate
and an iron block.

This template represents the edge of refinement.

Where power is no longer controlled…
only directed.

It transforms your armour - from the purity of Diamond...to the corruption of Vinestone.

# 🛠️ The Vinolium Upgrade Template
Forged from advanced materials:

- X6 Iron
- X2 Vinolium
- X1 Activated Vinolium

This template redesigns your Diamond armour, now just a schematic for total power. Untouchable. Impecable. Pure, not corrupted.

When purity meets enhancement, we get Vinolium Armour.

It transforms your armour - from the purity of Diamond...to the corruption of Vinestone.

# 🌿 New Materials: Forgewood

Born from the peace, but shaped by chaos.

Pinecones (uncooked) → Forge into Forgewood(strong).
Cooked Pinecones → Become Ironwood(even STRONGER).
...or use them as food.

Forgewood is the beginning.
Ironwood is the evolution.

# 🌲 Youngwood Forest
A towering expanse of ancient trees.
Quiet. Vast. Untouched.
But within its leaves…
the forest offers its gifts.
A pinecone, how...simple.
A seed of life, a seed of power.
9 of them and you got wood.
Cook 9 them and craft them into.....wood(but stronger).

# 🌾 Mudlands
Endless plains of mud and stillness.

No mobs.
No life.

Just silence.

Something here feels… wrong.
Too silent.
Too peacefull.
It hides a dirty secret.
That will reveal itself.
In the next update.


# ✨ The Power Within — Enrichment(you get it by eating cooked pinecones btw)

With great power comes… something greater.

*The Enrichment effect.*

A state of enhanced being—where the player is elevated beyond normal limits:

- Faster attack speed
- Increased oxygen capacity
- Enhanced movement and flight speed
- Increased damage

A moment where the player becomes something more.

Not just stronger—

enriched.

# 🧪 Distortion of Reality — Hallucination

A state beyond confusion.

A world warped by unstable power.

Far beyond Nausea…
far beyond discomfort…

This is Hallucination—a deep distortion of perception, where reality itself begins to break.
To get a potion of Halucinations.
Take the toxic.
The corrupted.
And channel its sin.
Into a bevrage.
That will haunt your dreams.
1 Vinestone in the Brewing station....

# ⚠️ Final Warning
This is not a mod of simple upgrades.
It is a descent into power.
A journey where every strength has a cost…
and every gain leaves a trace.

Vinolium empowers and purifies.
Vinestone corrupts and overpowers.

And what you become…
…depends on what you’re willing to endure. Love or Sin. Control or Power. 
also remember to not download beta versions, they may have unfinished features :))
